entities.summary: Raúl Porras Barrenechea was a Peruvian diplomat, historian and politician. He was president of the Senate in 1957. He was the Minister of Foreign Affairs between 1958 and 1960. A well-known figure of the student movement in San Marcos in the early 20th century, Porras became one of the most prominent Hispanist historians of his generation and a leading figure of the Peruvian diplomacy.

entities.summary: Raúl Porras Barrenechea was a Peruvian diplomat, historian and politician. He was president of the Senate in 1957. He was the Minister of Foreign Affairs between 1958 and 1960. A well-known figure of the student movement in San Marcos in the early 20th century, Porras became one of the most prominent Hispanist historians of his generation and a leading figure of the Peruvian diplomacy.
